series.name: Crowns & Chaos
series.pitch: Illegal street racing, ruthless motorcycle clubs, and mafia alliances, all colliding in one town. Each book is a standalone romance.

series.name: Outside the Ropes
series.pitch: A dark romantic suspense trilogy about a fighter who learned to survive long before she learned to box. Read in order. The complete series is also available as one box set.

box_set.title: Outside the Ropes: The Complete Series

series.name: Standalones
series.pitch: Complete stories with no cliffhangers. Start anywhere.

books.title: Ride
books.tagline: Some rides are worth the crash.
books.hook: Her brother rules the underground racing scene. He's the boy she swore she was over.
blurb: Evelynn Marsano's been gone for a year, but very little's changed. Her brother still rules the underground racing scene. The same girls still hate her. And the same boy still makes her heart race and resolve weak. But this time, she won't let him get close enough to hurt her. Not again. Not like before.

Weston Burke is only in town to set up a few street bike races, make some money, and have a little fun. Getting involved with his sponsor's little sister? That was never part of the plan. Especially when it'll piss off more than just her brothers. It'll wreck everything he's worked for. He knows better, but he can't stop.
Some rides are worth the crash.
books.series_note: RIDE is a standalone romance in the Crowns and Chaos series, an introduction to a world of illegal street racing, ruthless motorcycle clubs, and love that breaks all the rules.

books.title: Wreck
books.tagline: Book 2 in the Crowns & Chaos series.
books.hook: The next ride into Crowns & Chaos. Cover reveal coming soon.
blurb: Book 2 in the Crowns and Chaos series. The cover reveal and full description are coming soon, and newsletter subscribers see them first.
Preorder now and it will land on your Kindle on release day.

books.title: Hustle
books.tagline: Where the football players are royalty and Andrew Fayden is king.
books.hook: She came to college to escape the rumors. He's the most talked-about guy on campus.
blurb: South Eastern University: where the football players are royalty and Andrew Fayden is king.

College was supposed to be Brook's chance to escape the rumors and the harassment that plagued her at home, but she hadn't planned on meeting Andrew Fayden. Now, she's finding it hard to think of anything else or anyone else. She's determined to wipe him from her mind though, because he is the definition of unavailable. He's got an on-and-off-again girlfriend always on the sidelines and a flood of girls willing to take over that position.

And his popularity makes it hard to keep a low profile, something she needs to do if she doesn't want to be pulled back into the drama of her past. Despite all the warnings, she's finding it hard to resist, and he's making it hard to say no.

books.title: Outside the Ropes
books.tagline: In the ring, Regan has control. Outside the ropes, she fights to survive.
books.hook: A foster-care survivor finds her addiction in the boxing ring, and in the gym's tattooed star fighter.
blurb: Regan Sommers spent her life fighting. Fighting foster parents, kids in the group home, and classmates. But the night she has to fight for her life changes everything.

Now, she's fighting for money in the ring, and from the first punch she's addicted. Every addiction has a price though, and this one is the gym's star boxer, Gage Lawson. He may come in an enticing tattooed package, but his demands are more than she can handle.
The responding officer from that night, Anthony Fields, comes with no demands. He wants whatever she's willing to give, and Regan can handle that. She can definitely handle him.

But no help comes string free, and Regan's not the only one with a hard past and scars to cover. The life she was trying to escape is nothing compared to the danger she's in the middle of now, and she can't fight her way out.
books.content_note: Contains mature content including drugs, sex, abuse, and explicit language that may be upsetting for some readers.

books.title: Inside Danger
books.tagline: She thought she'd found someone to love outside those ropes.
books.hook: What Regan found was danger, and there's no easy way out.
blurb: Regan thought she had found a new life. She thought she'd found something to love in the ring. She thought she'd found someone to love outside those ropes. Someone who loved her.
But what she found was danger. And there's no easy way out.
books.content_note: Contains mature content including drugs, sex, abuse, and explicit language that may be upsetting for some readers.

books.title: OtherSide of Fear
books.tagline: Can they make it to the OtherSide of Fear?
books.hook: Regan and Gage have fought their entire lives. Now they fight side by side.
blurb: Regan and Gage have fought their entire lives. For themselves. For each other. Now together, side by side.
As new fears arise, mixing with the old ones of their past, will they be strong enough to make it through? Can they make it to the OtherSide of Fear?
books.content_note: Contains mature content including drugs, sex, abuse, and explicit language that may be upsetting for some readers.

books.title: It Goes On
books.tagline: Her one-night stand refuses to stay one night.
books.hook: Thirteen moves by twenty, a father she never knew, and a family built on secrets.
blurb: Kate's just moved for the thirteenth time, and she's only twenty. She just met a father she knew nothing about. And her mother's a liar. That about sums up why she got mind-numbing, forget-your-name drunk, but her reckless attempt to forget reality has backfired.

Now, her one-night stand refuses to be contained to one night, and his connection to her new family has made him impossible to avoid. His cocky swagger is hard to resist, but Kate tries to do just that. Especially since getting involved with him would pull her into a love triangle with very little love.

Kate isn't looking for love; she needs friends. Not that she's going to make any. She doesn't trust anyone in her new, fast world of wealth, privilege, and lies. And she should be wary. She's only skimmed the surface of the secrets surrounding her.
